title: Outdoor gyms, lit exercise tracks and ski tracks in Sweden (utegym, elljusspår, skidspår)
description:
2,162 places in all 290 Swedish municipalities: 1,125 outdoor gyms, 190 lit exercise tracks and 847 cross-country ski tracks, with municipality, county, coordinates, equipment stations or length, lighting and surface where mapped. Compiled from OpenStreetMap (extract 2026-11-13).

Map and per-municipality pages: amblecoach.com/sv/traning-utomhus.
